current_universe_construction: DS-050 and DS-100 appear to use current-active symbols only
risk: Symbols that delisted (bankruptcies, acquisitions, privatizations) are excluded, creating upward performance bias

delisted_securities.justification: Must include delisted securities to avoid survivorship bias. Estimated 10-20% of historical universe may have delisted.

historical_constituents.justification: Index membership changes over time; must use point-in-time constituents

historical_sector_classification.justification: GICS classifications change; must track historical sector assignments

historical_market_cap.justification: Market cap categories (mega/large/mid/small) change; must use point-in-time classification

historical_liquidity.justification: Liquidity filtering must use point-in-time data to avoid look-ahead

universe_construction_methodology.description: Use CRSP or Russell indices for historically valid universe construction. Include all securities that were ever in the universe during the study period.
universe_construction_methodology.key_principle: A stock that was in the universe on date T must remain in the training data for that date, even if it later delists.
minimum_requirements: All active symbols as of study start date
All delisted symbols with delisting date >= study start

survivorship_bias_estimate: If 15% of symbols delisted and delisted stocks underperform by 20-40%, ignoring delistings biases IC upward by approximately 3-6%
